verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise launch blog claims 'fully customizable' AI summaries that adapt to meeting purpose and functional role, which maps to the core of per-meeting-type note shaping. It is a single marketing claim and never describes how templates or saved prompts are created, selected or assigned. missing for 10: documented custom template/saved-prompt creation, explicit per-meeting-type assignment (discovery call, 1:1, standup), plan availability details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format

citations.quote: Otter's fully customizable, AI-powered meeting summaries automatically extract actionable insights based on meeting purpose and for different functional roles, such as sales, recruiters, project managers
